Commentary.Commentary: Right then! The ODI series has kicked off in style with both teams giving it their all but in the end it was India who came out roaring. Both teams will now clash for the second ODI on 19th January, 2017 in Cuttack at 1330 IST. Do join us for the same. Until then, it's goodbye from us. Cheers!

MAN OF THE MATCH, KEDAR JADHAV starts by saying it's a great feeling as his contribution helped India win the game and that too in front of his home crowd. Credits his skipper for his innings and says that he is inspired by the way Kohli goes about his business during a run chase. He admits that running between the wickets with Kohli isn't easy at all and also informs that his cramps are fine now.

INDIAN SKIPPER, VIRAT KOHLI is really happy with this chase and says it will take some time to sink in. He is elated that from 63/4 they chased down 350 in spite of the opposition having four quick bowlers. Praises Jadhav for his rollicking effort and credits him for the temperament he showed. Shares that he said to Jadhav to just stay there and England shall panic which eventually happened. Continues praising Kedar by saying that getting a ton at number 6 requires guts and this should be a special moment for him. On India's bowling, he replies that it was a placid pitch and they went for too many towards the end. Ends by crediting the English side for giving a good fight and thanks the crowd as well for supporting.

ENGLISH SKIPPER, EOIN MORGAN is a bit disappointed with what just happened. Mentions about the fluent partnership between Kohli and Jadhav which took the game away from them. Adds even 350 is not enough and feels they didn't play their best today. Credits Stokes for putting his hand up during the business end of the innings with the bat. Ends by saying that they would look to put a better show next time.

A great beginning for Virat Kohli as the permanent skipper in ODIs! The chase master once again was in his elements and one cannot undermine the importance of Kedar Jadhav, who also stroked a valuable century. The local lad batted with great pace and never allowed the pressure to mount on his skipper. However, he was not very swift between the wickets, he had the strokes to make up for it. Overall, India will be pleased with the outcome of this match where they were once tottering on 4 for 63. For the record, this was Kohli's 15th hundred in a successful ODI chase, the most by any batsman, going past Sachin Tendulkar. What a player!

England will be distraught at the moment! They put up a brave batting show to pile on a big total and their bowlers got them off to a brilliant start as well. The visiting team had India on the mat after picking four wickets quickly but then had no answers to Kohli and Jadhav's brilliance. The English team though got a sniff once they broke the big stand but failed to capitalize. Stokes, Ball and Willey were among the wickets but they weren't effective enough in creating pressure.

What a run chase from India! They have scaled a gigantic target to go 1-0 up in the 3-match ODI series. They stuttered early on in the chase but the superlative 200-run partnership between Kohli and Jadhav brought the run chase back on track. Things got tensed towards the end when both these batsmen got out, but India's lower order batsmen held their nerves and dragged the home team beyond the finish line. Hardik Pandya towards the end showed great maturity and Ashwin sealed the deal with a biggie. This is India's second highest successful run chase in ODIs.

SIX! That will do! Ashwin says even I want to chip one and sends this loopy ball down the ground over long on for a maximum. A glory finish to an emphatic chase. INDIA WIN BY 3 WICKETS! Kohli is all smiles and he would be happy about the fact that his side hasn't let him down. Customary handshakes all around.
SIX! Up and over! Loopy leg spinner outside off, Pandya stands put and hits it cleanly over extra cover for a maximum all the way. Scores are leveled!

NOT OUT! Pandya survives! Full length ball outside off, Pandya taps it towards the off side and they take a single. There is a shy at the bowler's end by Stokes and it hits. The ball deflects towards mid-wicket and they try to take another one. The fielder once again fires a throw to Buttler who takes the bails off. It is referred upstairs and replays show Pandya has made it in. So, two runs added to the total.
A run out appeal against Pandya is taken upstairs. His body language shows, he has made it in. Let's wait and find out...
Ashwin eases it down to long off for another single. Doing it nicely is Ash.
Tossed up around off, Pandya tries to smash it through the off side but mistimes it. Doesn't matter as the ball goes past extra cover and they take a single.
Loopy leg spinner around off, Ashwin drives it past covers for a single.
Drifting in from around middle, it's bunted back to the leggie.
Adil Rashid is brought back into the attack! 12 needed from 18!
Short of a length ball outside off, Hardik taps it towards the off side and sets off. Ashwin sends him back in time as the fielder from point was too quick to the ball. A dot ball to end the over.
Fuller on the pads, flicked towards deep backward square leg for a single.
Ashwin is showing the intent here! He's not a good runner but wants the second and gets it. Ashwin gets his drive past covers and hurries for a brace.
Fuller in length and around off, Ash drives it but finds the cover fielder.
Pandya gets back and tucks it towards the leg side for a single.
Wide! Another short ball outside off, bounces further and Pandya stays as it is. The umpire stretches his arms and it's called a wide.
This one shoots off the deck and Pandya could only tap it down.
Good running! Fuller and angling in, Ashwin flicks it through mid-wicket and some good running between the wickets allows them to come back for a double.
The batsman has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery. One run added to the total.
This time Ashwin plays a ramp shot towards third man but it's cut off. A single picked up.
Fuller and angling in, the batsman looks to flick but gets a leading edge towards point for a single.
FOUR! Shot, that! Short of a length ball outside off, Stokes gives no room but Pandya arches back and plays the upper cut to perfection to send it down to the third man fence for a boundary.
Pandya drives this full ball straight to covers.
Punched off the back foot through covers by the batsman. They pick up a single.
FOUR! Drilled! Fuller in length and outside off, Pandya gets forward and drills it all along the carpet through covers for a boundary.
Length ball outside off, Ashwin looks to steer it towards third man but gets an outside edge instead for a single.
HP looks to cut but gets a bottom edge down to third man for a single.
Ashwin had a tough day with the ball and would like to make up for it by batting through and staying there with Pandya.
Back of a length ball outside off, Pandya rides the bounce and taps it to point.

OUT! Ball gets Jadeja! Short of a length delivery outside off, Jadeja could have easily nudged it around the corner but goes for a big pull shot. Ends up top edging it high in the air towards mid on where the leggie, Adil Rashid takes it safely. 33 needed from 35 balls. England still very much in this contest. As the saying goes, "It's not over, until it's over!" Meanwhile, Ravichandran Ashwin is the next batsman in!

Bye! Bad bounce, can't blame Buttler there. Slower one outside off, Ravindra looks to cut but misses and it goes towards the keeper. The ball dips in front of Jos and due to the bad bounce it goes off his pads. The batsmen take a bye.
Jadeja works it towards the leg side but the man at short mid-wicket cuts it off to deny the batsmen a single.
Fuller and on the pads, Hardik flicks to long leg for another single.
Shortish on middle, gets on top of the bounce and pulls it in front of square for a single.
Good length ball on middle, flicked towards short mid-wicket for nothing.

Chance of a run out! Back of a length ball on middle, Pandya swivels and plays a tennis forehand shot towards mid on. They take Moeen Ali on who fires in a throw at the bowler's end but misses. A risky single taken.
Change of ends for Ben Stokes. 37 needed off 42 balls.
Fuller on the pads, flicked through square leg for one.
Wide! Slower one outside off, Pandya backs away and tries to slap it through the off side but fails to get any bat. The umpire calls it a wide, close call though.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot.

Overthrow! On a length and just outside off, Jadeja pulls it towards short mid-wicket and sets off. Moeen Ali collects and has a shy at the bowler's end. The fielder doing the back-up fails to collect it and now they get a single.
Short outside off, cut straight to the man at point. Pandya wanted the single and there is a throw made at the non-striker's end but it misses the stumps.
FOUR! Good shot, Jaddu! Good length ball outside off, Jadeja adjusts well and pulls it past the man at short mid-wicket for a boundary.
Wide! Short of a length ball outside off, Jadeja doesn't go after it. The umpire has his arms stretched to call it a wide for the height.
Leg bye! Comes steaming in and hurls in a length ball on middle and leg, Pandya looks to tuck it away on the leg side but gets it off the pads down to fine leg. A leg bye taken.
Jake Ball returns!
Still can't stop the singles! Fuller and angling in, it's clipped towards square leg for a run. 6 singles from the over. 46 needed from 8 overs!
Drops it short on off, punched off the back foot through covers for a single.
Fuller on the pads, eased down to long on for one more.
Comes in with the angle, it's quicker as well, Jadeja camps back and chops it in front of cover for a single.
Tosses it up around middle, Pandya knocks it down to long on for a single.
Leg bye! Darts it in around middle and leg, Jadeja comes forward to flick but it goes off the pads towards the leg side. They cross and umpire Dharmasena signals it as a leg bye. 300 up for India!
Moeen Ali is back on! A slip in place. 52 needed from 54 balls!
Good length ball, defended off the back foot.

NOT OUT! More of a desperate review, that! Angles it in from around off, Jadeja hops and looks to flick it across the line. Misses and is hit on the pads. They appeal but the umpire stays unmoved. England opt for the review and replays show it was in line but would have gone over the stumps. The ball rolled off the pads and a leg bye is picked up as well.
England have reviewed an LBW appeal against Jadeja.
Good length ball on off, pushed towards cover-point for a single.
A low full toss outside off, pushed towards covers for a single.

FOUR! All timing! Angles in a length ball on middle, Jadeja gets back and tucks it with pure timing wide of mid on. Rashid gives it a chase but it seemed like it was just for the sake of it. The ball wins the race.
Angles in a length ball, Pandya looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls towards the keeper. A single taken.
Punched off the back foot by the batsman to mid on.
Ravindra Jadeja walks out to bat next, replacing Jadhav!

OUT! A body blow in the chase for India! Jadhav was struggling with cramps and now has got out. Ball digs in a short ball on middle and off, Jadhav swivels with the pull shot and hits it over square leg. But there isn't enough distance behind the shot and Stokes grabs the catch at deep square leg. The local lad walks back after playing an outstanding knock. 61 needed off 60 balls!
Short again, outside off, this time Pandya plays a ramp shot down to third man for a single.
Zippy delivery, short and outside off, 140 kph, Pandya tries to run it down to third man but misses.
A touch short and angling down the leg side. Kedar helps it on its way to fine leg for one.
On a length and outside off, hit through the line, found the gap at covers and a single taken.
Slower short ball on middle, pulled through deep square leg for a single.
Fuller on middle, Jadhav drives it through mid on and scampers across for a quick single.
Short and outside off, cut straight to the man at backward point.

FOUR! Beats the man! Another short ball down the leg side, this time it's Kedar Jadhav who does the rest. He not only has power but has timing too. Helps it past the man at short fine leg with a controlled pull for another boundary. Stokes is gutted.
The batsman plays it with an angled bat and guides it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
FOUR! Easy pickings, that! Strangles it down the leg side, Pandya gets across and plays a controlled pull shot down to the fine leg fence for a boundary to start the over.

SIX! He is struggling but he still wants to take India home. When the intent is there, nothing can stop you! Back of a length delivery outside off, Jadhav stands put, swivels a touch and slams a pull over mid-wicket. Clears the fence and the crowd is up on its feet now.
Kedar Jadhav is struggling big time with cramps. Physio comes out. It's not looking good for Jadhav. But it appears he is going to continue...

Kedar Jadhav is down on the ground! He sends Pandya back, his mother in the crowd looks worried, the English players walk up to him. Back of a length ball on middle, the local boy looks to pull but gets a top edge that falls in the safe zone near mid-wicket. He loses the balance and falls down and hence no run is taken.
On a length and outside off, Jadhav looks to poke at it and is lucky to get away. Easy take for Buttler behind and Ball has his hands on his head.

SIX! Down the track and away she goes! A length ball around off, Kedar Jadhav skips down the track and goes bang over the bowler's head for a biggie all the way. His parents are in the stands lauding the effort. The crowd is cheering and is right behind him.
Back of a length ball outside off, HP hops and slaps it through extra cover for a single.
Good length on off, tapped towards the off side.
Jake Ball is back into the attack.
Top edge but safe! A snorter from Stokes, Hardik looks to pull but the ball keeps climbing on him. He gets a top edge over Buttler's head for a single.
Shortish outside off, Pandya looks to cut but fails to get any bat on it. There was an extra bounce there because of which he missed.
Short of a length ball outside off, Pandya punches it towards cover-point.
Stays behind the line and defends it down.
Hardik Pandya walks in next!

OUT! Got him! Yes, England have got the big fish here and that too at the right time! Back of a length ball outside off, Kohli is early into the shot as he slices it towards extra cover. Rashid from mid off comes in but David Willey comes across to his right from covers and pouches it safely. Virat Kohli walks back but not before setting it up for his mates. 88 needed from 82 balls.
200-run stand between Kohli and Jadhav!
Short of a length ball on middle, Jadhav pulls it over square leg for a single.
Outside off, dabbed once again towards third man by Jadhav to keep strike.

FOUR! 2nd ODI ton for Kedar Jadhav and what a knock this has been! He came in when his side was under immense pressure and delivers. He got some hearing from Kohli but now gets a pat on the back. Landed outside off, Jadhav opens the face and glides it ever so elegantly down to third man for a boundary. A quickfire hundred!
Bangs in a short ball outside off, Jadhav stays to let it go over him to the keeper.
Short and wide outside off, Kohli gets it between cover and point for a single.
FOUR! Just a flick of the wrists! Fuller in length and outside off, Kohli gets across and flicks it uppishly towards deep mid-wicket for a boundary. Boy, he makes these shots look so easy.
Fuller in length, angling in, flicked through mid-wicket for a single. Clearly Kedar is struggling, not a good sign for the home side.

Jadhav gets some medical attention. This has to happen when you have Kohli as a partner. He will ask you to run for anything and everything. The physio is out. India need him to stay as long as possible...
Stays in the crease, lets the ball come on the bat and dabs it towards third man for a single.
Back of a length ball outside off, it rises off the deck and Kohli leaps to slap it towards sweeper cover for a single.
Short of a length ball on middle, Kohli plays a swipe/pull towards mid-wicket.
Angles it down the leg side, Jadhav tucks it towards backward square leg for a single. He is limping at the moment. Literally jogged to get to the other end.
Fuller in length and around off, driven past mid off for a single.
Angles it in on middle, flicked away on the leg side for a single.
Fuller on middle, driven towards mid on. 106 needed from 96 balls.
Wide! Once again sprays it down the leg side, Jadhav looks to go after it but fails to get going this time.
FOUR! Deft! Fuller and down the leg side, it's the leg cutter, Kedar just helps it on its way fine down the leg side. Easy pickings for the KJ.
Fires in a yorker on the stumps, Jadhav does well to keep it at bay.
Landed outside off, dabbed down to third man for a single.

SIX! How on earth did he play that? Stand and deliver stuff! Slower bouncer outside off, Virat Kohli allows it to come on the bat and just lifts it with a straight bat to dump it over the mid-wicket fence. I still can't believe it. Looks good every time you watch it in the replays. Ravi Shastri on air says, that kind of shot can demoralize any bowler!
Angles in a length ball on middle and leg, Jadhav picks it up well as he pulls it in front of square for one.

Up in the air... lands safe! Short of a length ball on middle, Jadhav looks to pull but gets a top edge which falls well short of the man coming in from deep backward square leg. A single taken. Just 3 from the over!
Strangles it down the leg side again, Kohli swivels and rolls his wrists to send it down to fine leg for a single.
Good length ball outside off, Kohli looks to cut but bottom edges it back to Buttler.
Fuller in length and around off, driven straight to mid off.
Back of a length ball on middle, pulled through mid-wicket for a single.
Bangs in a short ball, angling down the leg side, Jadhav ducks to evade it.
Ben Stokes is back into the attack!
Drinks break. The current partnership has put India on course of getting the target. England need wickets to bounce back.
27th ODI hundred for Virat Kohli, 17th while chasing!

SIX! Take that! What a way to reach a century! Full in length and angling into the batsman, Kohli walks down the track and smacks it straight down the ground for a biggie. The crowd has gone bonkers. What a way to start your permanent captaincy stint! 122 needed off 108 balls and the chase master is up and running. England under pressure!
Nearly a run out! Kohli taps a full length ball to cover-point and rushes down the track in search of a run. Jadhav sends him back and the skipper ain't happy.
Fuller and straighter, Kohli pushes it off his pads but finds short mid-wicket.
Full and on middle, Kohli picks it off his pads and flicks it to mid-wicket. Dot ball.
Kohli on 99!
Angling down the leg side, nudged away fine down the leg side one.

Good length ball angling into the batsman, Kohli taps it down to point and crosses for a quick single. The throw at the striker's end misses the stumps, there is a chance for an overthrow but not taken.
Chris Woakes comes back into the attack.
SIX! Shot! Rashid bowls it slower through the air, full and spinning away, Jadhav this time goes with the turn and lofts it cleanly over extra cover for a biggie. 130 needed off 114 balls!
FOUR! Nearly a biggie! Rashid drags his length short on off, Jadhav goes deep inside the crease and pulls it against the spin over mid-wicket for a boundary. 150-run stand comes up!
Short and outside off, spinning away, Kedar gets back and cuts it through point for a couple of runs.
Gets down on one knee and sweeps it straight to short fine leg.
Slow loopy ball on off, pushed back past the bowler to long off for a single.
Flighted full ball on off, driven off the front foot to short extra cover.
Adil Rashid is back on.
Fullish and around off, Kohli taps it down to covers and takes a single.
Full and outside off, Kohli reaches out and swats it to sweeper cover for a couple of runs.
FOUR! Cheeky! Reaches 94! Short and wide outside off, Kohli stays back and just uses the pace of the bowler to loft it over short third man for a boundary.
Angles across a full ball outside off, Jadhav pushes it with an angled bat to short third man where the fielder dives to his right to stop the ball. They pick up a single.
Full and in the line of the stumps, Kohli stays back and dabs it to backward point for one. 200 up for India!
A touch short in length outside off, Jadhav guides it to short third man and they take a single. There is a direct hit at the striker's end, the ball deflects but no overthrow taken.
Floated one on middle, flicked in front of square leg for a run. 153 needed off 126 balls!
Jumps out of the crease to a full ball and lofts it over mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
Quicker, flatter and shorter on off, Kohli gets back and taps it down to short third man for a single.
FOUR! Cheeky! Loopy off spinner around leg, Kohli plays a good late flick shot and places it fine down the leg side for a boundary.
Slow loopy full ball on middle, quietly played in the gap at mid-wicket for a run.
Flighted ball on middle, a touch on the shorter side, Virat gets back and punches it through covers for a run.
Full and outside off, driven down the ground to long off for one.
Pitches it full and outside off, slower in pace, Kohli pushes it to covers and looks for a run. He is sent back and Virat is not happy with his partner.
FOUR! Great bat speed! On a length and angling away from the batsman, Kohli stays back to make room and drills it square of the wicket on the off side for a boundary.
Good length ball on off, Kohli tries to tap and run but it's close to the keeper and hence they decide against it.
The keeper comes up.
On a length around middle and leg, Jadhav walks across and tickles it off his pads to short fine leg. A single taken.
Fuller length ball on off, Kohli walks down the track and drives it straight down the ground for a single.
David Willey is back into the attack.

FOUR! Fine shot! Flatter and shorter around off, Jadhav hangs back and powers it over mid off. Good awareness shown by the local man, he knew mid off was up and hence took the risk. 170 needed off 138 balls!
Takes a step forward to a full ball and pushes it back to the bowler.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket. They pick up a single.
A touch short and outside off, Jadhav cuts it wide of short third man and takes a single.
Allows the ball to spin back in and flicks it through mid-wicket for a single.
Advances down the track and punches it to the off side. It's not in the gap.
Loopy and around leg, Jadhav sweeps it straight to short fine leg.
Strokes a full ball down through mid on for a single.
Flicks a full ball to mid-wicket. An unnecessary shy at the striker's end, Buttler fails to collect and they take a single.
Driven through mid on by the batsman. One run added to the total.
Fires a quicker one outside off, Kohli tries to steer it through the line but misses.
SIX! Great shot! Tossed up ball on off, spinning in, Kohli skips down the track and thwacks it over mid-wicket for a biggie. This partnership is going nicely for India.
100-run stand between Kohli and Jadhav!
FOUR! Flatter full ball on middle, Jadhav runs down the track and hammers it over the bowler's head. The long on fielder runs across to his left to stop the ball but fails to pull it back.
The batsman works it down the leg side. One run added to the total.
Flatter and shorter on off, Kohli advances down the track and pushes it towards mid-wicket.
Walks forward and punches a shortish ball to the bowler.
Loopy ball on middle, Kohli eases it through mid-wicket and runs the first run hard. Wants the second but his partner is on the slower side.
Full and on middle, Kohli hangs back and pushes it with an angled bat to short third man.
Full and on the pads, tickled down to long leg for one.
Loopy ball on middle, flicked through mid-wicket for a single.
Shortish and on off, Virat gets back and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Floated ball around leg, quietly tapped in front of square leg and picked up a single.
Driven towards the mid on region. They pick up a single.
Flatter and shorter on middle, Jadhav goes deep inside the crease and pulls it powerfully to deep mid-wicket. A single taken.
Floated off spinner on middle, helped wide of short fine leg for a single.
Shimmies down the track and works it to deep mid-wicket for one.
150 up for India! The batsman works it down the leg side. They pick up a single.
Spinning down leg, Jadhav tries to flick but misses.
Walks down the track and eases it to long on for a single.
Maiden ODI fifty for the local lad, Kedhar Jadhav!

Fifty for Jadhav! The local lad gets a warm round of applause. Full floated ball on off, Kedar plays it with soft hands to square leg for a run. Handy knock but he needs to carry on and support his skipper.
Driven towards the mid on region. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Flatter and on off, punched to long off for one.
Lunges to a full ball and works it towards short fine leg for a run.
Hangs on the back foot and hits it to mid-wicket.
Goes deep inside the crease and helps it through square leg for one.
Flighted around leg, spinning down, Jadhav fails to flick and the keeper also fails to collect. They run a couple of times and it's given as runs. Maybe, it came off the gloves.
Joe Root to roll his arm now.
Quietly works a full ball through mid-wicket and rotates the strike. Smart batting.

FOUR! Moeen errs in his length and bowls it short outside off, Jadhav goes deep inside the crease and cracks it wide of short third man for a boundary. Played it very late, almost off the keeper's gloves.
Full floated ball on off, flicked away with power through mid-wicket for one.
Flighted on middle, Jadhav goes back and helps it in front of square leg for a single.
Loopy full ball on off, Jadhav gets forward and defends it back to the bowler.
Flighted ball on middle, flicked behind square leg for a single.
Moeen Ali is introduced into the attack. 219 needed from 180 balls!
Floated one outside off, driven straight to the cover fielder.
FOUR! Shot! Rashid once again is on the shorter side, around leg, Jadhav kneels and clobbers it via a pull shot to the deep square leg fence.
Long on comes up.

Short ball on middle, Jadhav turns with the pull shot, fails to middle it but does well to clear mid-wicket. The long on fielder moves across to his right to stop the ball. They manage to come back for the second.
Mid on drops back.
Spinning away from the batsman, Kedar runs it down to widish short third man for one.
Loopy full ball outside off, Kohli drives it off his front foot to covers.
Flatter ball on middle, Kohli gets back and hits it straight to mid-wicket.
Walks down the track and turns it through mid-wicket for a single. Kohli wants the second run but Jadhav is not interested.
Full in length and outside off, Kohli advances down the track and drives it firmly to covers. It goes on one bounce to the fielder inside the ring. Not a clean stop but no run taken.
The batsman guides it to third man. One run added to the total.
Ball digs in a short ball on off, Jadhav doesn't risk of playing the ramp shot. Called a wide for height!
Short and wide outside off, Kohli flashes his bat through the line, fails to middle it and it runs off the outer half of the bat to third man. One run added to the total.
Jadhav opens the face of the bat and helps it to third man. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Back of a length ball on middle, Kohli tries to work it on the leg side but gets a leading edge towards covers. A single taken.

SIX! Boom! Rashid goes slower through the air and serves a full flighted ball outside off, Jadhav latches onto it, knew the mid on was up and hammers it over the fence for a biggie. Risk-free shot from the local lad!
50-run stand up between Kohli and Jadhav!
Kohli has played it towards mid-wicket. One run added to the total.
Loopy around off, 82 kph, Kohli has defended it by getting right behind the line of the delivery.
39th ODI fifty for Virat Kohli!

Drags his length short and lands it on middle, Kohli goes deep inside the crease and pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs. Huge cheer from the crowd as the Indian skipper reaches his fifty! India need to bat as long as possible.
Quicker full ball around the pads, Kedar nudges it to fine leg and picks up a single.
Long on comes up.
Flatter and on the pads, tapped towards square leg for a run.
A little halt in play. Physio has come out and having a chat with Kedar Jadhav.
Strides forward to a full ball and strokes it through covers for a single.

Pitches it full and around off, Jadhav drives it firmly off his front foot, past the short extra cover fielder and the mid off fielder moves across to his left to stop the ball. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Slower cutter outside off, Kohli plays a late dab down to third man and rotates the strike.
Good length ball on middle and leg, worked behind square leg for a run.
Brings a length ball back into the batsman, around off, Kohli walks across, gets too close to the line and chops it down towards third man for one.
Slightly short and outside off, Kedar once again runs it down to third man and picks up a single.
Jake Ball is back into the attack. Change of ends for him.
Spinning away from the batsman, Kedar dabs it down towards short third man and collects a single. 8 runs off the over!
FOUR! Nicely put away by the home boy! Shortish and on middle, Jadhav goes down on one knee with the pull shot and nails it over square leg for a boundary.
Googly around off, Virat gets back and punches it to long on for one.
Loose delivery, short and around off, Jadhav goes back and lofts it over mid-wicket. There is a fielder in the deep and hence only a run.
Flatter and shorter around off, Kohli hangs back and punches it to sweeper cover for one.
Flighted full ball on middle, Kohli plays it with a straight bat and pushes it towards mid on.
Adil Rashid comes into the attack.
Drinks are on the field now!
Bangs in a short ball on middle, Kohli plays a tennis forehand shot towards mid on. A single taken.
Opens the face of the bat and steers it past point for a single.
FOUR! Back-to-back boundaries! A length ball on off, Jadhav gets across and flicks it through wide of mid on. Rashid puts in a dive but it beats him and races away to the fence.

FOUR! Cut away! Short and gives a bit of width which allows the local lad, Jadhav, to free his arms. He cracks one through point and Ball in the deep tries to stop it with a dive but fumbles and parries it to the rope.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. They pick up a single.
Outside off, pushed towards deep backward point for a single.
Fuller on off, Kohli instead of driving it towards the off side, shuffles a bit and whips it towards mid on. Fails to get the right connection and it goes straight to Adil at mid on.
Shuffles a bit and nudges it towards wide of mid on for a single.
Angles in a length ball from around off, Jadhav looks to defend but gets an inside edge on the pads as the ball rolls towards covers.
Back of a length ball outside off, VK dabs it towards third man for a single.
Good length ball on middle, Kohli tucks it wide of mid on. Rashid gives it a chase and keeps them down to a couple.

FOUR! Ahh! That's oozing class! Fuller in length, width is there, Kohli makes a good stride forward, meets the pitch of the delivery and unfurls a classical textbook cover drive. No need to run for those, stand there and admire.
FOUR! Back of length ball on middle, Jadhav pulls it over mid-wicket. No one in the deep and he is off the mark with a boundary.
Wide! Back of a length ball outside off, Kedar doesn't want to take any risk. He simply lets it go.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Gets back and across to tuck this towards fine leg for a single.
FOUR! Classical! Length ball and on the stumps, Virat Kohli stands tall and just caresses it with a full face of the blade down the ground. Rashid from mid on dives but the ball beats him with ease.

Excellent stop! Eoin Morgan the man there. Fuller and around off, Kohli drives it on the up but Eoin the man at short cover dives to stop a certain boundary. England aren't giving anything to the Indians at the moment.
Fuller in length and around off, defended off the front foot.
Flicked through the leg side for a single at square leg.
Kedhar Jadhav is the new man in, replacing Dhoni!

OUT! Top edge! Another one bites the dust and the Indians are going nowhere in the chase. Ball bowls a back of a length ball outside off, Dhoni was a step out of his crease and looks to pull this. The ball climbs on him and he is cramped for room. He still goes with the shot and top edges it towards the on side. David Willey from mid on settles under it and grabs the catch safely. 288 needed from 229 balls.
Short and just outside off, MSD punches it towards Roy again at backward point.
Shuffles a bit and clips it towards wide of the mid on fielder for a single.
Fuller in length and outside off, driven straight towards the cover fielder.

Ouch that must have hurt! Good length delivery outside off, Dhoni cracks it towards backward point as the ball dips in front of Roy who gets a hand on it and then gets a blow on the face. He's down in some pain but is quickly up. Jason, you are a brave boy.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman. A dot ball to end a superb first over, Stokes.
Stays back and tucks it past short leg for a single.
FOUR! That's flayed! Dhoni comes down a step, more of a confidence stride and drills it behind point for a rocketing boundary. Is off the mark in style.
Good length ball, skidding through, Dhoni looks to cut but is beaten all ends up.
Ex-skipper MS Dhoni joins Kohli in the middle.

OUT! Stokes strikes! Once again he bowls a length delivery down the leg side, asking Yuvi to fiddle with it. He does so and pays the price for the same. Edges one and Buttler behind the stumps swiftly moves to his right to pouch a regulation catch. They appeal and keep on appealing and the umpire after taking his time raises his finger. Yuvraj falls after a promising start.
FOUR! Tickled! Fuller and down the leg side, Yuvraj doesn't miss out on that one. He gets a fine tickle down the leg side and picks up a boundary.
Wide! Stokes sprays it down the leg side, Yuvi fails to clip it away.
Powerplay 2 signalled. Maximum 4 fielders allowed outside the circle.
Angles it on from around off, Yuvraj looks to flick but closes the face of the bat early and gets an inside edge on the pads. The ball rolls towards the slip region and they take a single.
Defended off the back foot by the batsman.
Fuller on the pads, flicked towards backward square leg for one.

SIX! In the air... just clears the fence! Risky stuff! Length ball and it keeps going away after pitching, Kohli tries to hit it over covers but the bat turns in his hands and ends up slicing it over Alex Hales at third man. The English opener gave his all to catch it but fails to do so.
Play and a miss! On a length and outside off, Kohli chases after it but is lucky as the ball just whizzes past the outside edge to the keeper.
Fuller in length and outside off, Kohli looks to drive but gets it off the inner part of the bat towards mid-wicket.
England bring in Jake Ball who replaces David Willey.
One more over left in the first Powerplay and India might look to score some free runs.
Keeps it short again on off, Yuvraj mistimes his punch towards covers.
A short leg comes into place now.

Edged away! Short and wide outside off, Virat throws his bat at it and gets it off the outer edge over backward point. He must have his heart in mouth for a while as Willey was sprinting across to his right but the ball falls short of him. A single taken.
India trying to rebuild and this partnership between Kohli and Yuvraj holds the key. So far, they have looked positive and have punished all the poor balls coming their way...
Good length ball, angling in, it's pushed towards covers.
Too high! Woakes bangs in a short ball outside off, more and more bounce as Kohli looks to play the ramp shot keeping his bat skywards. Is beaten by the extra bounce.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Gets behind the line to this length ball and works it towards mid on.

FOUR! That made a cracking sound of the bat! Kohli admires it as well. Certainly will tell you Yuvraj's confidence. Willey goes short again and Yuvraj doesn't miss out this time. Just like the first ball of the over he connects once again and sends it on the bounce towards mid-wicket for a boundary. 10 off the over.
Straightens a bit after pitching, YS leaves it alone.
Short on off, punched a bit squarer on the off side as Roy fields it with a tumble.
YS defends it from within the crease.
Length delivery on off, punched towards the cover fielder.

SIX! Pulled away in style! A back of a length ball on off and comes up at a nice height too. Yuvraj Singh stands put and deposits this with a pull over mid-wicket for half a dozen. He played well in the first warm-up game against England, can he do the same tonight?
Good leave! Just a fractionally short on off, VK shoulders his arms to it.

FOUR! Impressive! Good length delivery on the stumps, Kohli shuffles and shuffles way across and picks it up with his strong bottom hand. Gets it over mid on and gets back-to-back boundaries to his name.
FOUR! That's a typical Virat Kohli stroke! Sees the width and goes after it. Is down the track and lofts this length delivery cleanly over extra cover for a boundary.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Fuller in length on off, driven back to the bowler who collects it with a forward dive on the bounce.
Good length ball on off, Kohli defends it down.
In the channel outside off, Yuvraj leaves it alone.
Yuvraj Singh walks in next, replacing Rahul!

OUT! What-a-ball! David Willey is absolutely pumped up and the silence button is pressed in the crowd. Hurls a full length delivery from around the wicket and this one nips back in sharply with the angle. Rahul looks to drive it through the off side but leaves a massive gap between his bat and pad and it's enough for the ball to sneak in and disturb the woodwork. Both the Indian openers are back in the hut.
Shortish in the channel outside off, VK opens the face of the bat and steers it down to third man for a single.
Gets behind the line and taps it towards covers. Kohli wanted a single but Rahul sends him back in time.
Fuller and on the pads, Kohli flicks it towards wide of mid on but Ball stationed there fails to stop it cleanly with a dive. He though takes the pace off as the batsmen take a couple.

SIX! Tonk! Good length delivery, angling in, Kohli comes down and across the track, gets to the pitch of the ball and hammers it wristily over mid-wicket. Terrific connection he made and got the desired result. This gets the crowd going as well.
Wide! Comes around the wicket and sprays it down the leg side, Virat looks to flick but fails to get any wood on it. Buttler moves to his left to take it.
In the channel outside off, defended gently off the front foot.
Shortish outside off, Rahul places it straight to the man at backward point.
Back of a length ball on middle, it's turned towards mid-wicket.
Fuller on off, Kohli plays a punchy drive towards mid off where Alex Hales dives full length to his left to stop it. Good intent from the English fielder. Kohli is away.
This one comes back again but Kohli covers the line to defend it.
Angles it in from around off, Kohli lifts his bat to let it be.
The newly appointed skipper, Virat Kohli arrives at number 3. Big hopes are pinned on his shoulders in this massive chase. Can he deliver?

OUT! Gone! Straight to the fielder! Willey draws first blood! Serves it on a length and just outside off, Dhawan comes a step ahead and tries to hit it over backward point. He gets good timing but much to his dismay it goes straight to Moeen Ali at third man who fumbles a bit but does well to cling on to it. Shikhar Dhawan flops again and the Indians have been rocked early in the chase.
Shikhar has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Comes from around the wicket and serves a back of a length ball outside off, Rahul gets back to dab but is a bit cramped for room. Gets it towards the slip cordon for a single.
On a length and just outside off, Dhawan comes down the track to have a go at it. Ends up getting it off the outer part of the bat over backward point for a single. He's off the mark.
Serves it on a good length just outside off, punched towards the man covers.
Angles it in on the pads, tucked towards square leg for a single.
Once again in the channel outside off, SD doesn't look at it.
Fuller in length and moves away nicely, Dhawan presses forward, lifts his bat and allows Buttler to collect it.
Fuller and curling in a bit, Shikhar drives it towards Adil Rashid at mid on.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Rahul dabs it towards the man at backward point to get off strike.
Good length ball outside off, it's punched square of the wicket on the off side.

Fuller in length and just around off, there is a bit of width as Rahul drives it a bit uppishly towards Morgan at covers. The English skipper has an unnecessary shy at the bowler's end as Dhawan was in the crease.
Touch short and moves away nicely, Dhawan is happy to take his time as he defends it with soft hands towards covers.
Full and swinging away, Shikhar shoulders his arms to it.
Good length ball outside off, Rahul taps it towards the on side and wanted a single. The fielder quickly gets to the ball and has a shy at the striker's end but misses. A single taken.
Fuller on the stumps, worked towards short mid-wicket.
Wide! Once again bowls it down the leg side, Rahul misses his flick again. Second wide of the over.
FOUR! Punched! A length ball just outside off, KL Rahul gets back and just times his punch past the point fielder. It's through the gap and he gets a boundary to his name. First one of the chase.
Wide! Sprays this one down the leg side, the batsman tries to flick it but fails to get any bat on it.
On a length and just around off, Rahul pushes it towards the man at point for nothing.
David Willey will bowl with the second new ball from the other end!
Back of a length ball outside off, Dhawan pushes it from the crease towards point. Just two from the opening over.
Wide! Bangs in a short ball on middle and leg, Dhawan is happy to sit under it. The umpire signals it as a wide.

Leg bye! Woakes goes too straight and ends up straying on the pads, KL Rahul looks to tuck it away on the leg side but misses. It goes off the pads towards the leg side and India are away with a leg bye.
Angles it in on middle, Lokesh covers the line and defends it back to the bowler.
Good length delivery on off, punched off the back foot towards cover-point.
Another length ball hurled in the channel outside off, left alone from Rahul.
Starts with a length delivery, angles it in a bit, KL Rahul makes a nice leave to the keeper.

Welcome back for the run chase. The task is cut out for the hosts and they would very well know they have a classical bowling attack up against them, won't be that easy to gun down the target. Let's see how they go about now. Shikhar Dhawan and Lokesh Rahul to open the batting for India. England start with Chris Woakes. A couple of slips in place. We are ready to rumble....
